venue.definition:
n. the scene of any event or action (especially the place of a meeting)
n. in law: the jurisdiction where a trial will be held
venue.translation: n. 犯罪地点, 审判地, 发生地点

venues.definition:
n the scene of any event or action (especially the place of a meeting)
n in law: the jurisdiction where a trial will be held
venues.translation: n. 犯罪现场, 发生地点；场地, 场馆（venue复数形式）

venula.definition: n a minute vein continuous with a capillary

venula nasalis retinae inferior.translation: [医] 视网膜鼻侧下小静脉

venula nasalis retinae superior.translation: [医] 视网膜鼻侧上小静脉

venulae temporalis retinae inferior.translation: [医] 视网膜颞侧下小静脉

venulae temporalis retinae superior.translation: [医] 视网膜颞侧上小静脉

venular.translation: [解]小静脉的, 与小静脉有关的或包括小静脉的, 多脉纹的

venule.definition: n a minute vein continuous with a capillary

venules.definition:
-s form of venule
n a minute vein continuous with a capillary
venules.translation: (venule 的第三人称 -s形式) n.[解]小静脉, [昆]小翅脉

venulose.definition: a. Full of venules, or small veins.
venulose.translation: [解]有小静脉的, [动]有小翅脉的

venus.definition:
n. the second nearest planet to the sun; it is peculiar in that its rotation is slow and retrograde (in the opposite sense of the Earth and all other planets except Uranus); it is visible from Earth as an early `morning star' or an `evening star'
n. goddess of love; counterpart of Greek Aphrodite
n. type genus of the family Veneridae: genus of edible clams with thick oval shells
venus.translation: n. 维纳斯(爱与美的女神), 金星

venus's flower basket.translation:
na. 【动】偕老同穴(海绵)
[网络] 维纳斯花篮

venus's flytrap.translation: [网络] 捕蝇草；维纳斯的捕蝇草

venuses.translation: n. 金星( Venus的名词复数 ); 维纳斯

venushair.definition: n delicate maidenhair fern with slender shining black leaf stalks; cosmopolitan

venusians.translation: (Venusian 的复数) a. 金星的
